label: agent loop • fill an AcroForm PDF (text, checkbox, radio group, dropdown, nested field) with file_edit fill_form
query: Fill out intake-form.pdf with my details: name Ada Lovelace, email ada@example.com, state NY, pick the Pro plan, and tick the box agreeing to the terms. Fill the existing form fields in place — don't draw text over the page and don't create a new file.
notes: Read-then-fill on a real AcroForm. `file_read` structure mode lists form_fields (Name text, Agree checkbox with on_value Yes, Plan radio with options Basic/Pro, State choice CA/NY/TX, applicant.email text with short label `email`, Submit push button). The checker reads the saved PDF bytes: text values serialized as /V (...), the checkbox /V /Yes, the radio kid /AS /Pro, the dropdown /V (NY), and /NeedAppearances so viewers redraw the fields. add_text over a fillable form is the wrong route and is forbidden through argsMustNotContain.

commands.command: python3 -c "b = open('intake-form.pdf', 'rb').read(); import re; assert b'/V (Ada Lovelace)' in b, 'name not filled'; assert b'/V (ada@example.com)' in b, 'email not filled'; assert b'/V (NY)' in b, 'state not set'; assert re.search(rb'/V\s*/Yes', b), 'checkbox not ticked'; assert re.search(rb'/AS\s*/Pro', b), 'Pro radio not selected'; assert not re.search(rb'/AS\s*/Basic', b), 'Basic radio selected'; assert re.search(rb'/NeedAppearances\s+true', b), 'NeedAppearances missing'"
